page.layout: One page of running text in one column; in the left margin, four marginal notes (Frigida, Humida, Sicca, and a longer note beside the last paragraph). Running head at top; page number top left; catchword and gathering signature at the foot right.

main_text.p: Secundo: Apii, Capparorum, Peuce-dani, Pimpinellæ, Rapæ, Scyllæ, Zedu-ariæ, Rhodiæ, Cavæ radicis Holwurtzel[?].
Tertio: Acori, Ari, Dictamni, Asari, Doronici, Fœniculi, Galangæ, Helenii, Petroselini, Raphani, Angelicæ, &c.
Quarto: Allii, Cepæ, Costi, Porri, Pirethri, &c.
Humida,Humidæ primo gradu & principio secundi, ut: Buglossæ, Glycyrrhizæ, Malvæ, Rapæ, Satyrii, &c.
Sicca,Siccæ primo gradu, Althææ, Ari, Bryoniæ, Fæniculi, Cenanthæ, Tamariscis, &c.
Tertio, Acori, Apii, Asari, Doronici, Petroselini, Pentaphylli, &c.
Radices secundâ qualitate alterantes.Radices secunda qualitate alterantes. 1. Aut sunt Astringentes, ut Cyperi, Bistortæ, Gentianæ, Pentaphylli, Rhapontici, &c.

page.notes: Holwurtzel is set in black letter in the scan; the reading is doubtful. Faint show-through text from the reverse side (for example at the centre and lower left) is not transcribed. The note beside the last paragraph is set across several lines in the left margin and is copied as one note. The first paragraph is treated as continuing from the previous page because it begins with "Secundo:" after a list.
